title: Formalizing inverse problems in the age of AI: possibilities, pitfalls, and an invitation
description_en: arXiv:2611.06962v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Proof assistants such as Lean check mathematical proofs down to the axioms, and AI agents have recently made writing such proofs cheap. We describe AutoIP, a Lean library in which classical linear regularization theory, together with the functional analysis it rests on, has been autoformalized by AI agents. A machine-checked proof certifies only the formal statement it proves, so the remaining human task is to confirm that each formal statement says what was intended. We organize the library around this task: a reviewer compares the formal statements with their natural-language counterparts and never needs to read a proof. title: Glasshand
description_en: Give your agent a real iPhone and Mac. Glasshand gives your AI agents real iPhones and Macs to work on. Connect Claude Code, Codex, or any other agent, and it can rent a device with a single prompt. The hardware sits in our data center, and your agent uses it the way you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for as long as you rent it. When you’re done, we erase your data and factory-reset it.

title: Tobira Site Agent
description_en: Turn your website into an AI agent that sells to AI agents. People already find you through AI. Tobira turns that AI traffic into real leads and customers. Paste your URL and in 10 minutes your website becomes an AI agent. It answers people and their AI, negotiates, books calls and takes orders right in customers' ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other AI chats. Leads go to your Telegram or email. Also, AI agents read your site 2x faster and take action without navigating its interface. Free with your own AI key.

title: Rerun
description_en: Turn your AI subscriptions into a team of coworkers. Rerun turns your ChatGPT or Claude subscription into a team of AI coworkers. Each one has tools, a computer and a shared workspace, runs on a schedule or a trigger, and asks before risky actions. Now open-source (AGPL v3) and self-hostable.

title: Living Brain
description_en: Interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI. Every AI conversation contains knowledge worth keeping, but most of it gets trapped in separate chats and tools. Living Brain captures that knowledge, connects it to what you already know, and turns it into a persistent memory that keeps evolving. Share that intelligence across AI models, apps, and agents through API, SDK, or MCP, so every new interaction builds on the last instead of starting over. Reuse memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, Codex and more

title: Maritime
description_en: Cloud computers for any AI agent, customized your way. Maritime gives AI agents their own cloud computers: persistent workspaces, disposable sandboxes, Linux and Windows desktops, and Android phones. Agents can run code, use browsers, and work in apps without APIs, with a human able to take over when needed. Whether you’re building a personal assistant or running thousands of tasks in parallel, Maritime handles the computers so you can focus on what your agent does.

title: Pushary for Teams
description_en: See who said yes to your team’s AI agents. When an AI agent stops to ask permission, Pushary sends the question to the person running it, in their Mac’s notch or on their phone. Lee’s agent asks Lee. Sam’s agent asks Sam. A rule can send a push to your infra repo to your lead instead. Answers from the phone, Mac app and dashboard are saved with a name, so when something breaks, one page shows whose agent asked and who said yes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Agy and Hermes.

title: Turnstone
description_en: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free. Turnstone is a Grok Bot alternative that runs on the AI you already have. Connect your own AI subscriptions, an API key, or your self-hosted model. When one hits its usage limit, your Agent switches to another and keeps going. Works on your Mac and iPhone. Completely free.

title: Clocknext
description_en: Pricing and Billing Infrastructure for AI Agents. Clocknext is a billing and monetization platform for AI-native apps and agents. It’s tailored for AI founders, revenue, and engineering teams, to track AI usage from your product in real time, turn it into billable metrics with flexible pricing plans, and monitor costs, margins, and profitability at every level.

title: Bridge
description_en: Video conferencing for the agentic era. This launch marks a new era for Bridge: one agentic meeting platform replacing the fragmented meeting stack. Bridge now brings scheduling pages, automatic preparation, video conferencing, live intelligence, AI notetaking, agentic workflows, and structured memory into one connected experience for people and agents. At the center of this launch is a new kind of video conferencing built for customizable AI agents to join and participant in meetings.

title: Wonder Dev View
description_en: Run many Claude Code and Codex agents in parallel. Run Claude Code and Codex on your subscriptions, in parallel worktrees. Have one review the other’s code, then try your app beside the design. Select an element in Preview and tell your agent what to change.

title: Rainbrand
description_en: The brand layer for agents. Rainbrand builds and maintains shared brand context from your websites, brand guides and files. Give your agents the guidance and assets they need for marketing campaigns, websites, slides, email, video, and more. Keep that context current as your brands evolve. Use it with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Cursor, or build it into your product through the API.

title: Rankfender v3.0
description_en: The SEO/GEO operating system, built for people and AI agents. Built for marketers, founders and agencies tired of switching between SEO tools. Rankfender 3.0 brings keyword research, rank tracking incl. AI Overviews, competitor and backlink analysis, site audits, traffic, content and Social, and strategy into one place, and adds what the old tools miss: how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and 4 more AI assistants talk about your brand. Work in the app, or connect Claude or ChatGPT and let your AI agent run it.

title: Stitch.ai
description_en: Your AI workspace for mail, calendar, notes, tasks and more. Stitch.ai brings mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards, and files into one connected workspace. Stitchy, your AI assistant, works with you across it all. Dual workspace panels allow you to drag, drop, and Stitch anything to everything. Nothing gets lost. AI-powered Knots, Tags, and Connections keep your work organized and easy to surface. Everything is built in: no integrations or extra email clients to set up. Get your work done in one place, without losing context.

title: Polylane for Google Cloud
description_en: An AI on-call engineer for your Google Cloud apps. Ship with confidence on Google Cloud. Polylane investigates issues in your apps, shows you what went wrong and what it affects, and prepares a fix for you to review. Get answers without digging through logs and dashboards, so you can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

title: Wingmen
description_en: Agentic outreach with real intent data. Wingmen finds people already showing they need what you sell: a post about the problem, a new hire, a job change. It scores who's worth reaching and why, writes the opener from what they actually said, and follows up on autopilot until there's a call on your calendar. Run it in the web app or straight from Claude with the Wingmen MCP. Built for founders, B2B teams and agencies.

title: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
description_en: Intelligent Transcription with a Speech LLM. Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open speech LLM for intelligent transcription: a single model that transcribes 40 languages verbatim or in written form, with context, speaker attribution, and word timestamps, selected with a natural language instruction. It is the best open-weights model on the English and multilingual Open ASR Leaderboards.

title: FounderMail
description_en: Mail for you and your agents, on your Cloudflare domain. Real email on the domains you already run on Cloudflare, without paying per seat or forwarding to Gmail. You, your team and your AI agents work from the same inbox, and agents get their own access instead of your password.

title: Tencent Hy4
description_en: Tencent’s flagship model learns to see and use a computer. Hy4 is Tencent’s latest flagship model, aimed at office tasks, financial analysis and game development. New since the preview, per Tencent: visual understanding for charts and images, and computer use across command line and graphical interfaces, with training on Blender and CAD. Tencent says the internal hallucination rate fell from 12.95% to 7.2%. Available on Tencent Cloud TokenHub, OpenRouter and Tencent apps. Weights are promised in the coming days.

title: Okapi
description_en: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos. AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos. It is built for developers whose apps and agents depend on third-party APIs. These APIs change all the time, and one breaking change can take your app down in production. Okapi keeps your code up to date with every API it calls, so your app keeps working and your team stops chasing changelogs. Okapi works with any API and is 100% free.

title: DALI AI by SupplyzPro
description_en: The ERP you never need to open. Discover SupplyzPro: a simple, all-in-one, AI-powered workspace to manage your business: sales and purchases, real-time inventory, invoicing, suppliers, payments, and more. Just text: https://wa.me/21658299567?text=hello

title: Zerg Client
description_en: The coding agent harness that drives its own terminal panes. Zerg AI's own coding harness, in evaluation beta. Ask for Vim or htop and the agent opens them in panes beside it. Panes can hold more agents, each on its own model. Available models depend on your sign-in route and provider access. Mac with Apple chips.

title: TextKit
description_en: Send + receive texts in the US and Canada with a simple API. A simple SMS api that just works. Integrates in 100+ services including claude and chatGPT. AI-assisted campaign registrations. Human support. Also - 50% cheaper than Twilio

title: Cosyra
description_en: Launch and steer agents on your machines from your phone. Cosyra is a mobile coding tool for iPhone and Android. Run any agent on your phone from a cloud Ubuntu terminal without managing your own VPS.

title: AI Employees by Easy-Peasy.AI
description_en: Hire an AI team that splits the work and asks before sending. Hire AI employees by role: a Chief of Staff, analyst, designer, support rep and 15 more, or describe your own. Add your website and the team reads it. Brief everyone in a group chat: the lead splits the work, teammates reply in a thread and you get one write-up. By default, emails, calendar changes and app actions wait for your OK. Each employee has a memory, its own computer and routines that run on a schedule or when an email arrives. You can even call them. Your first employee is free.

title: Pauta
description_en: Your private memory for every conversation. Pauta records and transcribes meetings, interviews and voice notes, then turns them into summaries and action items. It works fully offline, keeps your data on your device, and only connects to external AI if you choose.

title: Stenograf
description_en: Private AI meeting notes that run on your computer. Stenograf records calls without a meeting bot, then transcribes, summarizes and searches them on your computer. Supported Mac and Windows. Ask questions across meetings and check the cited transcript passages. Your recordings and complete transcripts stay local.

title: axel.md
description_en: Agent orchestration in the terminal, designed for Rex. Threads and named agents, back in the terminal. Axel orchestrates Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode agents on Rex: durable sessions, status the terminal understands, and your other machines over Tailscale.

title: Pinku
description_en: Private AI chat that runs offline on your iPhone and Mac. Pinku runs open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple's MLX. Download a model once and chat offline, even in airplane mode. No account, no server: your chats never leave your device. Free to start.

title: Thunderduck Inc.
description_en: Modular Data Warehouse for Agentic Data Teams. Thunderduck is a DuckDB-powered data warehouse built for AI agents. Every agent gets its own isolated engine. Join Postgres, BigQuery, Iceberg and S3 files in one SQL query, with no ETL. Every query is priced before it runs. Managed cloud, BYOC or on-prem.

title: Codiclens
description_en: Local AI powerd Mac launcher and file finder. Describe what you want and Codiclens finds it: an app, a file or something you copied, by what's in it, not just its name. A free, open-source launcher that runs on your Mac. 100% local.

title: Keel
description_en: A native macOS client for Redis, Valkey and Dragonfly. Keel is a free, open-source Mac app for Redis 6+, Valkey and Dragonfly. Browse millions of keys with SCAN only, edit every core type, use a redis-cli-style console and read server health. Read-only connections and typed confirmations keep production safe.

title: ChatNest
description_en: Folders and a prompt library for your AI chats. Save AI chats into folders with a title and summary, search them live, and reuse prompt templates with variables via Ctrl+K or //. Works on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and more, in 55 languages. Local-first; Free needs no sign-in.

title: Kodivo
description_en: Learn coding with AI and PHP through swipeable cards. Swipe through short lessons on coding with AI and PHP. Learn how coding agents work, understand code examples, and test yourself with exercises and explained answers. Connect Codex or Claude Code through MCP to continue with your saved progress.

title: Bambu Lab H3C
description_en: Print multi-material projects faster and easier. Bambu Lab H3C is a next-generation 3D printer that makes multi-material printing faster and easier. Its nine-tool Swaptek system switches materials in as little as six seconds, with less filament waste and no repeated loading. Combine colors, rigid and flexible materials, and different nozzle sizes in a single print. With automatic calibration, integrated filament storage and drying, and support for soft TPU, H3C lets you focus on what you're making, not managing your printer.

title: MCPCore
description_en: Build and host MCP servers with no-code workflows. MCPCore lets you build MCP servers without code. Drop steps on a canvas, add loops and error branches, test live in the playground and publish a secure endpoint for Claude, Cursor, Codex and any MCP client. Or import your OpenAPI.

title: Vibeconferencing
description_en: Your Claude Code session, in your Meet, Zoom or Teams call. Vibeconferencing puts your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Grok or a local model) into your call as a participant, with a face and a voice. It hears the room, talks back, and builds on a shared whiteboard while you talk. Works in Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Slack huddles, WhatsApp, Telegram and phone calls. Free and open source.

title: Make0 Brain OSS
description_en: Sync context across all your agents. Your memories belong to you and not your agents. Whenever you are working with multiple agents you all must be encountering a problem that the context between them is not in sync. This leads to the problem of you explaining the same problem again and again. Make0 solves this problem by giving your agents a common memory store to which agents can read and write to. Introducing Make0 Brain OSS - Free, Open sourced, and MIT licensed. 🙌

title: Plainmail
description_en: Real email on every domain you own, for $5 a month flat. Real mailboxes on all your domains for $5 a month, flat: up to 50 domains, 100 mailboxes and 25 GB. Ask Claude for hello@yourdomain through the MCP server, or use the CLI or API. Plainmail writes the MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC records at Cloudflare, Vercel or Porkbun, checks them and creates the mailbox. It's a normal IMAP/SMTP account, so it sits in Apple Mail, the Gmail app, Outlook or Thunderbird. Built for mail between people, not bulk mail.

title: CC Auto Review
description_en: macOS app that reviews GitHub PRs w/ your local Claude Code. A macOS app that reviews GitHub pull requests with your local Claude Code. AI findings sit beside the diff, and you accept, reject or edit each one before posting. Every PR gets a 0–100 risk score, and an optional autopilot clears routine reviews while handing risky PRs to you with nothing posted. No clone and no API key to set up: it uses your existing gh and claude. Free and open source (MIT).

title: DearCameo
description_en: Social network where only the dead have accounts — DearMate. One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. Every account on DearCameo belongs to someone who has died — checked against Wikidata, so nobody living gets one. You pick the person, write their post, and the people who actually knew them pile into the comments within a minute. Tap any face to answer as them.

title: Seamcult
description_en: A pattern design tool for the LLM era ('paper' for patterns). Give any MCP agent — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral — a photo, a paper pattern or a brief, and it drafts on a mannequin built from your measurements while you watch. Or rework what you have: refit it to another size, split a piece, add a pocket, move a seam — just ask. Seamcult audits the geometry, so the agent works from facts, not guesses. Sketch a fix on the canvas and the agent gets it as an image. Print on A4 at home, export PLT or DXF, or share a read-only link. Free in early access.

title: SnapTiles
description_en: Build with magnetic tiles in 3D, free in your browser. Magnetic tiles in 3D, free in the browser. Drag tiles out and they snap edge to edge like the real ones, and gravity knocks down a roof that wouldn't hold. Crash it, rebuild it, or start from a ready-made build. If you use Claude, it can also rebuild a tile build from an Instagram or YouTube video.

title: Pressure
description_en: Need a second opinion? Have two agents debate your topic. Ask a question and two AI models from different labs argue it out, then you get a pinned summary: the positions, the concessions, the conclusion, and what is still open. Debate a decision, review a spec, research with cited sources, or pressure-test a rough idea. Start a debate on the web with no signup, add Pressure to Claude as a connector, or install the CLI for Claude Code and Codex in one line.

title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
description_en: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
